verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OWEEBWE nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Kabaka-agaba-obuwa,
Omwana wa Dawudi,
Mu linnya lya Mukama,
Eyajja gye tuli.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bamalayika nabo
Baasuuta-erinnya lyo;
Abantu n'enitonde
Mu nsi ne baddamu

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Abayudaaya-ensansa
Baakukulembeza;
Naffe tuyimba-ennyimba
Nga tutendereza.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Bo baakutendereza
Eyafa ku mit:
Ffe tusinza n'ennyimba
Kabaka-afuga-ensi.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Ennyimba ez'abaana
Ggwe wazikkiriza
Naffe-era totugaana
Byonna bye tusaba.

verse.name: v11
verse.lines:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
